h1-k1: Sofía sits on the floor at home and strokes Tito, her plump gray tabby cat.
h1-k2: Sofía imagines a big dog as her mother shakes her head and points to Tito.
h1-k3: Sofía steps into a pet shop filled with dogs of different sizes.
h1-k4: Sofía looks worried as she holds one bill. A picture of several bills above the big dog shows it costs more than she has.
h1-k5: Sofía reaches out to welcome Pancho, a small brown dog with one floppy ear. Tito sits beside her.
h2-k1: Pancho eagerly leans toward a slice of pizza. His bowl of dog food sits untouched behind him.
h2-k2: Sofía and Pancho walk into a café with pizza, coffee, and bread on the counter.
h2-k3: Sofía smiles as she lifts her cup of coffee. Pancho has his eyes on a slice of pizza.
h2-k4: At a café table, Pancho bites a slice from a large pizza while an older man in a beret looks surprised.
h2-k5: The older man pets Pancho and shares a smile with Sofía over a pizza with a slice missing.
h3-k1: Sofía looks from the kitchen into the garden for Pancho. His bed is empty.
h3-k2: Sofía scans the school courtyard for Pancho while children with backpacks gather by the steps.
h3-k3: A slice of pizza appears in a bubble above Tito as Sofía turns toward the café entrance.
h3-k4: Sofía steps into the café and spots Pancho eating another slice of pizza at the older man's table.
h3-k5: Sofía gestures to Pancho, with a house in a thought bubble. Pancho keeps his eyes on the pizza and reaches toward it.
